name: expense-tracker-root
description: Full-stack Expense Tracker Application with React, Express, and MySQL

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
